description: This file defines the interface class IMediaPipelineIpcClient for the Rialto media player client IPC communication, including method declarations for notifications related to playback state, position, network state, media data requests, QoS updates, and buffer underflow events.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineIpcClient
classes.description: Interface class for IPC communication with the Rialto media pipeline, providing virtual methods for various notification events.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notify the client of a change in playback state.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify the client of a playback position update.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notify the client of a change in network state.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify the client that media data is needed, providing source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify the client of a QoS update for a specific source.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify the client that a buffer underflow has occurred for a specific source.
